 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 3.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLES OF CONVERSION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>FROM A </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>DELAWARE
STATUTORY TRUST </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TO A </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>MARYLAND CORPORATION </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SEPTEMBER&nbsp;17, 2026 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sagard Private Income Fund, a Delaware statutory trust (the &#8220;<B>Company</B>&#8221;), hereby files these articles of conversion (these
&#8220;<B>Articles</B>&#8221;) with the State Department of Assessments and Taxation of the State of Maryland (&#8220;<B>SDAT</B>&#8221;) for the purposes of converting from a Delaware statutory trust to a Maryland corporation (the
&#8220;<B>Conversion</B>&#8221;) under <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;3-903</FONT> of the Maryland General Corporation Law (the &#8220;<B>MGCL</B>&#8221;) and Section&nbsp;3821 of the Delaware Statutory Trust Act (the
&#8220;<B>Act</B>&#8221;) and certifies: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" WIDTH="100%" BORDER="0" STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" ALIGN="center">


<TR>

<TD WIDTH="12%"></TD>

<TD VALIGN="bottom" WIDTH="1%"></TD>
<TD WIDTH="87%"></TD></TR>


<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:2.20em; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>FIRST</U>:</P></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top">The Company is a Delaware statutory trust, formed by the filing of a Certificate of Trust with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware on March&nbsp;20, 2026. The name under which the Company was originally formed was
&#8220;Sagard Private Income Fund&#8221;. The name of the Company immediately prior to the filing of these Articles is &#8220;Sagard Private Income Fund&#8221;.</TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="font-size:1pt">
<TD HEIGHT="8"></TD>
<TD HEIGHT="8" COLSPAN="2"></TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:2.20em; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>SECOND</U>:</P></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top">The name of the Maryland corporation into which the Company shall be converted is &#8220;Sagard Private Income Fund Inc.&#8221; (the &#8220;Converted Entity&#8221;).</TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="font-size:1pt">
<TD HEIGHT="8"></TD>
<TD HEIGHT="8" COLSPAN="2"></TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:2.20em; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>THIRD</U>:</P></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top">The Conversion has been approved in accordance with the provisions of Title 3, Subtitle 9 of the MGCL and in the manner and by the vote required by its governing document and the laws of the State of Delaware.</TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="font-size:1pt">
<TD HEIGHT="8"></TD>
<TD HEIGHT="8" COLSPAN="2"></TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:2.20em; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>FOURTH</U>:</P></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top">The manner and basis of converting the outstanding number of units of beneficial interest in the trust estate, par value $0.01 per share, of the Company into shares of stock in the Converted Entity is as follows: Upon completion of
the Conversion, all issued and outstanding common units of beneficial interest in the Company, if any, will be immediately converted into the same number of shares of common stock of the Converted Entity on a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-for-one</FONT></FONT> basis and shall constitute 100% of the issued and outstanding stock of the Converted Entity.</TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="font-size:1pt">
<TD HEIGHT="8"></TD>
<TD HEIGHT="8" COLSPAN="2"></TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:2.20em; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>FIFTH</U>:</P></TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top">The Conversion is effective as of 12:02 a.m., ET on September&nbsp;18, 2026.</TD></TR></TABLE>
</DIV></Center>
